name: Pete Geren
desc: United States Secretary of the Army and former congressman

offices.t: United States Secretary of the Army
United States Secretary of the Air Force (acting)

summary:
Preston Murdoch "Pete" Geren III (born January 29, 1952) is an appointed member and President of the Board of Managers of the Fort Worth Independent School District and the president of the Sid W. Richardson Foundation in Fort Worth, Texas.
Previously, he was an attorney and politician who served as the 20th United States Secretary of the Army from July 16, 2007, to September 16, 2009. He is a former member of the United States House of Representatives from Texas's 12th congressional district, under the Democratic ticket.
